claim: Bottom-up store-level reconstruction for 8 FL Europe locator countries (DE, NL, BE, PL, CZ, AT, LU, HU; about 27-29% of FL Europe). Corrected live census on 2026-10-07: 153 listed stores (DE 78, NL 22, BE 15, PL 12, CZ 10, AT 6, LU 6, HU 4), of which about 150 are actually trading. In the window from the deal close to now there were about 14-17 gross closures and 2-3 openings, a net of about -11 to -15 on about 165 stores (-7% to -9% in 13 months, roughly 6.5-8% a year). That compares with a benchmark of about 4% a year for Europe as a whole (581 to 559) and a flat Bloomberg consensus. At least 10-12 of the closures carry post-FYE (after 2026-01-31) evidence, which works out to at least about 9% a year gross in this sample.
data_point: Live 2026-10-07: 153 listed (DE78 NL22 BE15 PL12 CZ10 AT6 LU6 HU4); ~150 trading after excluding 3 stale listings. Verified in-window closures: DE 6 (Muenchen PEP #3339, Nuernberg #3325, Wetzlar #3301, Osnabrueck #3218, Fulda #3350, Hamburg AEZ #3184); NL 4-6 (Haarlem #1209, Utrecht Oudegracht #1148, Kids FL Rotterdam Lijnbaan #61105, Kids FL Leidschendam #61234, plus Hoofddorp #1146 and Amsterdam Buikslotermeerplein #1133 with uncertain timing); BE 2-3 (Kortrijk #2122, Louvain-la-Neuve #2129, plus Liege Belle-Ile #2123, window Apr-2025 to Aug-2026); HU 2 (Mammut #13808, Vaci u. 14 #13851). Openings: Hamburg Westfield Ueberseequartier #3282, Amsterdam ArenA Outlet #1992, likely Praha Europark #13452. PL/CZ/AT/LU: 0 closures in the window.
source_name: FL RioSEO store locators (stores.footlocker.<cc>), live crawl + Wayback city-page captures + live 301 checks; Google Maps review trails (Apify dataset in raw/D_w1_gmaps_fl_europe_full.csv)
verifier_note: Downgraded from A to B and corrected. (1) The scraper counted Berlin Tauentzienstr. 17 (#3334) as a closure in the window. That is REFUTED: a Google review dated 2025-06-17 says 'Der Laden ist leer' (the store is empty), so it closed before the deal. The Berlin city page kept a stale card through 2025-10-07, which I verified in Wayback captures 20250323, 20250712 and 20251007 (card present) and 20260120 (gone). This shows that locator 'last-listed' dates can lag real closures by months. (2) The 3 listed-but-closed stores all closed before the deal or have undated windows: Recklinghausen Palais Vest (Google review 2025-01-11 says the shop no longer exists, matching the CY2024 Recklinghausen closure in the FL Germany accounts), Liege Vinave d'Ile (Google says closed 2023-12; Sudinfo 2023), and Liege Belle-Ile (closure window 2025-04-18 to 2026-08-27). They show the locator overstates trading stores, not that closures accelerated. (3) Hoofddorp's last Google review is 2025-02-01, so its timing is uncertain. (4) The live census is CONFIRMED: Budapest city page shows 13802/13803/13804/13807, and Brno lists Vankovka #13413. The west-census confirmed file put HU at 3 and CZ at 9 because its sitemap regex missed the malformed fids (13803 '550_ 31_13803', 13413), so HU=4 and CZ=10 is the correct count. (5) Most individual closures in this list already appear in D_w1_landlords-malls, D_w1_gmaps-closed, D_w1_chatter and C_w1_labor-rest. The novel part is this 8-country net time series and run-rate. Inference: since Europe reported only -14 net from FYE to 8/1/26, the at least 10-12 post-FYE closures in this ~29% sample point either to gross Europe closures well above the net figure or to closures continuing into Q3 FY26. Vaci u. 14 still had normal Google reviews on 2026-09-21 (per D_w1_gmaps-closed), which points to a Q3 FY26 closure. Separately, the scraper's city timeline shows Recklinghausen #3373 and Koeln #3445 absent by 2026-07-10; these were not counted here and are unexplained.

claim: Netherlands: FL closed 2 of its 3 remaining stand-alone Kids Foot Locker stores in 2026: Rotterdam Lijnbaan 70-70a (#61105) and Leidschendam Mall of the Netherlands, Liguster 57 (#61234). Both were listed on FL's locator in February 2026 and now return 301. Only Kids FL Rotterdam Zuidplein (#61132) is left in NL. The adult FL stores in the same locations (Lijnbaan 75 #1105 and Liguster 53-55 #1234) stay open, so this looks like format consolidation rather than a market exit.
data_point: Rotterdam city page (Wayback 2026-02-15): ids 1105, 1135, 1145, 1232, 61105, 61132. Live 2026-10-07: 1105, 1135, 1145, 1232, 61132. Leidschendam city page (Wayback 2026-02-15): 1234, 61234. Live: 1234 only. Both Kids store pages return 301 to their city page.
source_name: FL Netherlands store locator + Wayback Machine
verifier_note: I verified the Wayback captures 20260215115446 (Rotterdam) and 20260215105814 (Leidschendam) against the live city pages on 2026-10-07, and the live 301s for lijnbaan-70-70a-1135_31_61105.html and liguster-57-47_31_61234.html. The Kids Lijnbaan store page was also live on 2026-05-14 according to the scraper's CDX data. On Google, the adult stores Lijnbaan 75 and Leidschendam #1234 still have reviews into Oct-2026. The other NL closures in the scraper's finding (Haarlem, Utrecht Oudegracht, Hoofddorp) are DUPLICATES of D_w1_landlords-malls. Hoofddorp's timing is uncertain because its last Google review is 2025-02-01. I rated this B rather than A because the Kids closures are small, same-location consolidations.

claim: Counter-evidence: FL opened a new store at Westfield Hamburg-Ueberseequartier (#3282) inside the DKS window. It was absent from the Hamburg locator page on 2025-07-12 and 2025-10-07 and present on 2025-12-06. It is open and still collecting Google reviews through 2026-09-29. Together with the Amsterdam ArenA Outlet and Praha Europark (already confirmed elsewhere), openings offset about 2-3 of roughly 14-17 closures in the 8-country sample.
data_point: Hamburg city page ids 3148, 3184, 3306 (2025-07-12, 2025-10-07) became 3148, 3184, 3282, 3306 (2025-12-06). The store page westfield-uberseequartier-49_31_03282.html returns 200 now. Google: OPEN, 15 reviews, latest 2026-09-29. Hamburg is net flat because AEZ #3184 closed in 2026.
source_name: FL Germany store locator + Wayback Machine + Google Maps
verifier_note: I verified 3 Wayback captures (20250712033022, 20251007173515 and 20251206025544) and the live 200. Caveat: the locator listing date may lag the actual opening; the mall itself opened in spring 2025 (outside knowledge, not verified here). Amsterdam ArenA Outlet #1992 is a DUPLICATE of A_w1_company-side-new (Combet post). Praha Europark #13452 is a DUPLICATE of C_w1_news-uk-iberia-rest; its first Google review is 2026-01-09, which supports an opening inside the window. Utrecht Hoog Catharijne #1242 first appeared between 2025-02-19 and 2025-10-07, so it may be pre-deal, and I did not count it.

claim: Counter-evidence: Poland (12), Czechia (10), Austria (6) and Luxembourg (6) show no FL store closures since the 2025-09-08 deal close. Every closed store ID found in these countries (PL Wola Park #13010 and Katowice #13006; CZ Praha Zlicin #13405; AT Graz #8106, Seiersberg #8112 and Wien Favoritenstr. #8109) has no Wayback capture since 2025 and closed before the deal. In this sample, closures since the deal are concentrated in Germany, the Netherlands, Belgium and Hungary.
data_point: Live 2026-10-07: PL 12, CZ 10 (incl. Brno Vankovka #13413 and new Europark #13452), AT 6, LU 6. The 2025-2026 Wayback 200 captures cover only currently-live IDs: CZ 13402-13409, 13451, 13452; AT 8102, 8105, 8111, 8201, 8254; PL 13014-13055.
verifier_note: I re-ran the Wayback CDX for stores.footlocker.cz/at/pl from 2025 onward (status 200). The only store IDs captured are ones that are live today, and no 2025+ capture exists for the closed IDs. D_w1_landlords-malls lists 'PL 1 (Czestochowa)' among removed store pages, but Czestochowa #13015 is live (city page and store page return 200, and it is in the sitemap). That entry looks wrong, or it refers to another store not identified here. I did not independently check LU beyond the scraper's live count of 6, which matches the west-census file.
